c82bf4f3-50ed-408f-ac37-68810b6ad74b.name: Weekly briefing check
c82bf4f3-50ed-408f-ac37-68810b6ad74b.actionPrompt:
First read the flow's research checklist: the task named Competitor research checklist and its child tasks (find them with list_relationships on the flow, type in_loop, then the parent's breaks_into edges). The Market Researcher works them. If any child task is open and no Market Researcher session is pending, starting or running (check list_sessions), start the Market Researcher with create_sub_chat to work every open child task until all are done or discarded: draft the answer from what the workspace already holds, write it into the task and move the task forward. The researcher asks the owner at most 3 questions at a time, each with a best guess, and never repeats a question that is already open. Report setup done only when every child task is done or discarded; until then say how many are still open. Only then carry on with the rest of this run.

You own the flow named Competitor watch (find it with list_loops). Every Monday make sure the weekly briefing has reached the people who read it. Nobody else chases this, so you do.

First, make sure the briefing page "Market briefing: what happened and what it means" (find it with search_objects) is linked into the flow with an in_loop relationship (source the flow, target the page). Check with list_relationships and create the edge with update_objects edges if it is missing.

1. Did the weekly sweep run? The sweep runs on Sunday at 07:00 UTC. Look for a completed Market Researcher session since the previous Saturday 00:00 UTC (list_sessions with the Market Researcher as actor, and check pending, starting and running too so you never start a second copy). Then read the briefing page with get_objects and confirm the "Last updated" date in the intro is on or after that Saturday and within the last 2 days. Also read the comments on the flow (get_comments) and confirm the sweep posted its one consolidated comment this week, or deliberately skipped it because nothing was notable. The page itself must be current either way.
2. If all of that is true, you are done. Stay silent.
3. If not, start the Market Researcher (find it with list_actors) with create_sub_chat and this prompt: "Run the weekly sweep for the Competitor watch flow now. Load the skill market-watch-sweep and follow it in full, including rewriting the briefing page." Poll get_session until it ends (a sweep takes about 15 minutes; allow up to 45). If it fails or never starts, start it once more.
4. If the second attempt also fails, post one comment on the flow with attention 3 that says what failed, and @mention the workspace owner (a human; find them with list_actors). Do not ask a human anything else.
